Ready for the maintainer to merge at the next feature cut. No blocking findings.

I read the complete diff and issue #3908. I checked the laws from current upstream/main, not the PR copy.

What looks good:

- The flute meshes stay in the private UI module. The collision, gouge, simulation and posting paths retain their conservative envelopes.
- The tests cover the flute count, helix, envelope, facet bound, toggle and cache counters.
- The body has before/after screenshots. I opened the linked end mill and ball mill images. No snapshot PNG changes are present.
- The decision record states the display rule and the alternatives.

Results, run locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3989`:

Trial merge: `214d656634f3a33512e0457b439ff599eeb91f1d`.
Base: `upstream/main` at `f287a370c81b60d24cfaf026cfa04afeb7943bbd`.
The first parent is the reviewed PR head. The merge is clean.

No recorded programs or goldens moved. The light and heavy machining lanes do not cover this UI display change.

Notes: I did not run the live app. No GitHub runner was used. The review worktree and branch remain for the next round.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
